title: Run HP-OS locally with persistent PostgreSQL
body:
## Parent

https://github.com/fvckzest/HP-OS/issues/22

## What to build

Start the planned Next.js service and small HP-OS website against private local Supabase, with reproducible setup and verification.

**Implementation stage:** Foundation. Work includes the HP-OS and LMNL responsibilities needed for this behavior. Use the two approved testing boundaries, keep external credentials on the Site backend, update affected repository guidance, and leave existing live Events on the current system. No visual review.

Guidance: [technology](https://github.com/fvckzest/HP-OS/blob/main/docs/technology.md).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A clean local setup applies version-controlled SQL migrations and runs the TypeScript Next.js application using direct SQL.
- [ ] The small website identifies HP-OS and its current capability without introducing an unapproved product or visual redesign.
- [ ] An API-boundary check uses real test PostgreSQL and demonstrates persistence across application restart; no new business endpoint is invented for testing.
- [ ] Local services remain private, generated database APIs cannot expose operational records, and Vercel configuration is prepared without claiming hosted database readiness.
- [ ] Document the working setup, verification command, and current capability in the repository guidance.

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately.

title: Recover durably queued work across worker restarts
body:
## Parent

https://github.com/fvckzest/HP-OS/issues/22

## What to build

A Site worker can inspect, claim, process, and report durable work without lost jobs or overlapping ownership.

**Implementation stage:** Foundation. Work includes the HP-OS and LMNL responsibilities needed for this behavior. Use the two approved testing boundaries, keep external credentials on the Site backend, update affected repository guidance, and leave existing live Events on the current system. No visual review.

Guidance: [api](https://github.com/fvckzest/HP-OS/blob/main/docs/api/api.md), [technology](https://github.com/fvckzest/HP-OS/blob/main/docs/technology.md).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Implement the existing notification-job inspection, claim, renewal, and dispatch/delivery-report contract against PostgreSQL; do not create a separate public queue API.
- [ ] Queued work and its triggering change commit atomically; interrupted or overlapping processing preserves work and follows lease fencing and safe replay rules.
- [ ] Use the same bounded HP-OS processing entry point for local scheduling and the prepared Vercel Cron configuration; Site execution remains separate.
- [ ] Exercise seeded operational work through API and scheduled-processing boundaries, including an expired claim and unknown dispatch that requires verification before resend.
- [ ] Resolve and document exact nested notification payload fields before LMNL depends on them, without changing the settled semantic contract.

## Local workbench handoff

Settled in [Settle incremental workbench delivery and verification](https://github.com/fvckzest/HP-OS/issues/61); follow the [implementation handoff](https://github.com/fvckzest/HP-OS/blob/main/docs/local-workbench.md#delivery-and-implementation-handoff). Existing implementation order, native dependencies, API contract and testing boundaries remain authoritative.

- [ ] Add job list/detail, claim/renew/report requests, separate HP-OS and Site processing observations, manual/automatic processing controls, controlled time, overlap and interrupted-claim/unknown-dispatch scenarios. Use the scheduler's existing bounded entry point and preserve verification before resend.

- [ ] Add the relevant shared catalogue entries, editable requests, guided steps, operational observations and functional checks with this capability. Include applicable success, expected rejection, retry/concurrency/interruption and safe recovery scenarios through the approved testing boundaries. Label unavailable/blocked prerequisites, actual versus simulated integrations, and evidence gaps; no visual review.

## Blocked by

- [Provision Site access and payment configuration](https://github.com/fvckzest/HP-OS/issues/24)

- [x] LMNL staff-authorized create/edit/publish operations persist an Event with exactly one Ticket offering; nested partial edits, nullability, guarded versions, and retries follow the contract.

Existing live Events stay on the current integration through that window.
